test_title: SSC Selection Post 2025 (Graduate Level) Official Paper (Held On: 24 Jul, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Given: (p)/(a) + (q)/(b) + (r)/(c) = 1 and (a)/(p) + (b)/(q) + (c)/(r) = 0, where p, q, r and a, b, c are non-zero, then the value of (p²)/(a²) + (q²)/(b²) + (r²)/(c²)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let x = p/a, y = q/b, z = r/c

Given: x + y + z = 1 and 1/x + 1/y + 1/z = 0

(xy + yz + zx) ÷ xyz = 0 ⇒ xy + yz + zx = 0

(x + y + z)² = x² + y² + z² + 2(xy + yz + zx)

1 = x² + y² + z²

**∴ Answer = 1**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

p/a + q/b + r/c = 1

a/p + b/q + c/r = 0

**Formula used:**

(x + y + z)² = x² + y² + z² + 2(xy + yz + zx)

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let x = p/a, y = q/b, z = r/c

⇒ x + y + z = 1

⇒ 1/x + 1/y + 1/z = 0 ⇒ (xy + yz + zx) ÷ xyz = 0

⇒ xy + yz + zx = 0

⇒ (x + y + z)² = x² + y² + z² + 2(xy + yz + zx)

⇒ 1 = x² + y² + z²

⇒ Required = (p²/a²) + (q²/b²) + (r²/c²) = x² + y² + z²

**∴ The correct answer is 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Substitution Trick

Replace ratios like p/a with variables to simplify expressions.

Symmetric Identity

(x + y + z)² identity helps connect sums and squares.

Reciprocal Condition

1/x + 1/y + 1/z = 0 ⇒ xy + yz + zx = 0.

Exam Shortcut

Directly jump to identity once xy + yz + zx = 0 is obtained.
